spec.expr: label_replace(count by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="assistant", container="assistant", cluster=~"$cluster"}) unless count by (image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="assistant", container="assistant", cluster=~"$cluster"} offset 5m), "version", "$1", "image", ".*:([0-9a-f]{7}).*")

spec.description: Health of the Grafana Assistant backend across dev clusters: API traffic, LLM usage and cost, background workers, and infrastructure.

followUps: Which cluster should on-call look at first?
Are LLM errors limited to one model?
Do restarts line up with the failed investigation runs?
insight.question: What needs attention in the Assistant backend, and what changed since the previous period?

spec.title: Requests by endpoint
spec.description: The 8 busiest endpoints in the selected time range. Health checks and profiling are excluded.

spec.expr: sum by (handler) (rate(assistant_http_requests_total{namespace="assistant", cluster=~"$cluster", handler!~"/ready|/metrics|/debug/pprof|/api/v1/health"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (handler) topk(8, sum by (handler) (increase(assistant_http_requests_total{namespace="assistant", cluster=~"$cluster", handler!~"/ready|/metrics|/debug/pprof|/api/v1/health"}[$__range] @ end())))

spec.title: Server errors by endpoint
spec.description: Hourly 5xx responses.

spec.title: p95 latency by endpoint
spec.description: The 6 slowest endpoints in the selected time range. Streaming and proxy endpoints are excluded.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, handler) (rate(assistant_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="assistant", cluster=~"$cluster", handler!~"/ready|/metrics|/debug/pprof|/api/v1/health|.*stream.*|.*/live|/mcp|/api/v1/a2a/.*|/api/events/.*|.*sandbox/commands|/api/v1/aisdk/.*|/api/cli/v1/proxy/"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (handler) topk(6, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, handler) (rate(assistant_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="assistant", cluster=~"$cluster", handler!~"/ready|/metrics|/debug/pprof|/api/v1/health|.*stream.*|.*/live|/mcp|/api/v1/a2a/.*|/api/events/.*|.*sandbox/commands|/api/v1/aisdk/.*|/api/cli/v1/proxy/"}[$__range] @ end()))))

spec.expr: sum by (cluster) (increase(assistant_worker_task_duration_seconds_count{task_type="lodestone.run", status="failed", cluster=~"$cluster"}[1h])) / sum by (cluster) (increase(assistant_worker_task_duration_seconds_count{task_type="lodestone.run", cluster=~"$cluster"}[1h]))
